title: saxifraga bronchialis subsp. compacta
intro: Saxifraga bronchialis subsp. compacta, commonly known as Alpine saxifrage, is a plant species belonging to the Saxifragaceae family. This perennial herb is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat respiratory issues, including bronchitis and coughs, due to its potential health benefits such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga bronchialis subsp. compacta include its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory tract, making it a popular natural remedy for respiratory ailments. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
